title: Creating String Art Figures with stringArt
text: functions stringArt follow common interface whenever possible. main arguments : n: number pegs points; k: step, factor, rule used create connections; col: line color; lwd: line width; plot: whether figure plotted; show_points: whether pegs shown; show_labels: whether peg labels shown; verbose: whether detailed audit information printed. function returns invisible list containing least: pegs: coordinates identifiers pegs; connections: table string connections; total_length: total string length; audit: audit information construction; meta: metadata figure parameters. compatibility previous versions Shiny application, returned objects may also include Portuguese aliases pregos, conexoes, comprimento_total.

title: Creating String Art Figures with stringArt
text: function stregion() places pegs along contour. contour supplied, function uses default contour. allows teachers explore String Art beyond standard geometric frames connect construction curves, boundaries, customized shapes. String Art generated default contour. custom contour may also used, depending implementation function. general idea provide set ordered boundary points let function sample pegs along contour.

title: Generate a hexagonal flower string art pattern — sthexaflower

what: Generate a star polygon string art pattern — ststar
title: Generate a star polygon string art pattern — ststar
text: ststar() generates classical star polygon {n/k} placing n pegs circle connecting peg peg k positions ahead.

title: Generate a star polygon string art pattern — ststar
code: ststar(   n = 5,   k = 2,   col = "blue",   lwd = 1,   plot = TRUE,   show_points = TRUE,   show_labels = FALSE,   verbose = FALSE,   radius = 1,   rotate = pi/2,   show_strings = TRUE,   template = FALSE,   draw_polygon = TRUE,   border_col = "grey50",   border_lwd = 1,   point_col = "black",   point_cex = 0.8,   point_pch = 19,   point_bg = "white",   label_cex = 0.7,   label_col = "black",   bg = "white",   main = NULL )

title: Generate a star polygon string art pattern — ststar
text: star polygon uses additive modular rule = ((+ k - 1) %% n) + 1. greatest common divisor gcd(n, k) determines number cycles. gcd(n, k) = 1, star single cycle. Otherwise, construction decomposes several independent cycles.

title: Generate a star polygon string art pattern — ststar
code: ststar()  ststar(n = 5, k = 2) ststar(n = 7, k = 2)  ststar(n = 8, k = 3)  ststar(template = TRUE)
